updates.note: Management guided for 7% to 8% revenue growth for FY26.
updates.quote: And revenue growth, the guidance is 7% to 8%, whatever is there, we will try to continue with that.

updates.note: Management stated guidance is 8% to 10% for medium term.
updates.quote: No, we are expecting double-digit growth from next year onwards. It may so happen in the current year also. But the guidance is 8%-10%.

updates.note: Reiterated 5-year capex outlay of Rs. 14,000 to 15,000 crores.
updates.quote: we have formulated a comprehensive CAPEX plan for the next five years, with an estimated outlay of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crore.

updates.note: Order book improved to Rs. 1,89,300 crores against previous position.
updates.quote: The order book of the company improved to Rs. 1,89,300 crores against the previous year order book position of Rs. 94,127 crores

updates.note: Nashik line expected to roll out first aircraft in the next couple of months (May/June 2025).
updates.quote: established the third line at our Nashik plant, which is expected to roll out in the next couple of months.

new_promises.statement: Maintain operating profit to revenue at 27% going forward.
new_promises.quote: we will be maintaining the operating profit to revenue at 27%.
new_promises.speaker: Barenya Senapati

new_promises.statement: Deliver 12 LCA engines in the calendar year up to December.
new_promises.quote: GE has promised a supply of 12 engines in this calendar year up to December.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil

new_promises.statement: Fly the Tejas Mark-2 prototype in the first quarter of next year.
new_promises.quote: we expect to fly the prototype in the next year, 1st Quarter of next year.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil

new_promises.statement: Conclude GE F414 engine deal in the current financial year.
new_promises.quote: And we expect that in this financial year; we will be able to come to a conclusion of this deal.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil

new_promises.statement: Reach capacity of 30 LCA aircraft per annum in the next two years.
new_promises.quote: I would say in the next two years, we would be able to reach that number of 30.
new_promises.speaker: D.K. Sunil
